text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Princess Headbutt!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! Kawakami Princess
has smashed through 40 roof tiles with a headbutt!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My. For mere earthen clumps such as these,
one does not even need to strike downward—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
J-Just by pressing down with her finger...!?
Crushed!! The tiles were pulverized like rice crackers~~!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
A round of applause for our two guests
who hyped up our Feat of Strength
Exhibition Match~~!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the morning session concludes!
For the afternoon exhibition, we'll be
handing it over to Yaeno Muteki-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oss!
While taking a stroll during the break—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Hah! ...Sei!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not yet...! Sharpness must be
honed even further...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To stir up a whirlwind of passion through martial prowess...!
Gentil-san and the others achieved exactly that...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then I must do the same...!
Nay, surpass both of them...!!

She seemed so focused that she hadn't noticed me.
However, the afternoon session was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ! Did you require something of me?
choice_data_list: Isn't it about time to head back?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is it that late already?
Thank you for alerting me.

Yaeno Muteki prepared to head to the stage.
Seeing her fiery resolve to captivate the crowd
with a performance beyond her rivals, I couldn't help but...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! The afternoon Exhibition Match!!
What kind of tile-breaking display will we witness today~~!?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hold on? Those movements look almost like a dance!
It's truly graceful, but what could this be...!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A technique that synchronizes every motion of the body
to maximize destructive force, perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...I see!
It looks remarkably impressive!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
How intriguing.
Will she fumble and swing wide from the momentum,
or will she—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Only beyond trial and adversity does the path reach its pinnacle.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(My gratitude to the two who displayed their magnificent feats.
And now—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall turn these cheers into thunderous applause!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Kongo Yaegaki Style—Shirabyoshi Strike!!!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
P-Pulverized...!!!!
Every single stacked tile has been smashed to dust...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Such bold decisiveness.
—Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Such grace, paired with the sheer might of a war god...!
—I think I just became a fan!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—...Oss!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: A clean hit—!! The tiles split cleanly right down the middle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Such refined poise coupled with overwhelming strength...!
It was just like watching PrinFigh!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—That horse girl... she's the real deal!
—I was completely mesmerized!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—...Oss!
Thank you very much!
